english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a sandy or pebbly beach.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the shore or beach by the sea.

examples.english: We went to the beach for a swim today.

examples.english: We spent the whole afternoon playing on the strand.
examples.traditional: 我哋成個下午都喺沙灘度玩。
